correctness.rationale: The direct character computation yields the degree-k Krawtchouk multiplier. The exact difference formula and the strict bound 2<R(p)<3 produce one fixed unique maximizing shell for 0<p<1. The congruence-sensitive A_*=−B_* lower bound and endpoint inequalities establish a strictly increasing critical multiplier with one zero in (0,1) and positivity thereafter. Character diagonalization, Schoenberg double centering and a Taylor expansion establish endpoint rank and asymptotics. CHECK.py independently verifies 784 parameter pairs and 701 direct characters with no numerical counterexample. Infinite correctness relies on explicit inequalities, not the finite tests.

value.rationale: For the canonical metric obtained by clipping Hamming distance at three, the sharp negative-type exponent governs existence and minimum dimension of Hilbert embeddings and universal Gaussian positive definiteness. The theorem gives a complete nonbinary q>=3 classification, including composite alphabets, one p-independent critical Fourier degree, a large endpoint nullspace and a q-periodic second-order threshold correction; these are natural nontrivial properties beyond classical single-shell spectra.
